title: L3-F3: spend_usage description must state the class-table-bound resource exception
description: Repair L3-F3 (evidence in eshyra-o9bd.16.3 notes). toolSpendUsage.ts ~31-35 tells the model that character abilities have no structured economy and to pass maxUses+reset on first spend, but usageCounters.ts ~928-980 derives Rage, Ki and Sorcery Points from the class table and rejects a declared economy. protocol.ts injects both, so the model gets contradictory instructions. Fix the description (and any other model-facing copy) to state the bound/unbound distinction; keep the engine's rejection. Evidence: a compact assertion that the published description identifies the distinction.
notes: Done by the Captain in commit 8cc290d6 on branch eshyra-o9bd.16.8. The toolSpendUsage.ts description now states the class-table-bound exception for Rage, Ki and Sorcery Points. The engine's rejection is unchanged, and protocol.ts already carried the exception. Test: classResourceActiveCapacity.test.ts checks that every CLASS_RESOURCE_BINDINGS displayName and the omission rule appear in the description. verify:worktree passed.
